title: IT60110: Human Computer Interaction
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NoneIntroduction to HCI methods. Interaction styles and general
design. Various user interfaces and interaction strategies. Programming usable
interfaces. Software architectures for user interface. Human factors of
interface design. Interface metaphors and conceptual models. Screen design. HCI
and World Wide Web. Task analysis. Usability evaluation, Collaborative systems,
Groupware and Coordination technologies.
